chip.description: Low-cost 8-bit CPU, widely second-sourced; common as a main or sound CPU.
chip.notes: Deliberately no chip_equivalence edge to the Ricoh RP2A03 (rp2a03g) in either direction (coverage.md §1.6): a 6502 supplies none of the 2A03's on-die APU, and the 2A03 lacks the 6502's decimal (BCD) mode, so a 2A03 standing in for a 6502 is valid only when the machine's software never uses BCD — a machine-dependent condition this schema does not hold.
